title: 从实验室到生产
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/10_APB - Moving Research into Production.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/10_APB - Moving Research into Production/src.py

points.K6: 风险分析：安全吗？值得吗？
points.K9: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例
points.K10: 显著性指数：范围、可逆性
points.K15: 画出从实验室到市场的路
points.S3: 田间试验要隔离、防扩散

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一条从实验台通向工厂和超市的道路起点，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the start of a winding path that leads from a lab bench to a small factory and a grocery store, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲成果怎样从实验室走向生产。

shots.scene: 工厂、天平、盾牌、试管四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a factory, a balance scale, a shield with a check, and a rack of test tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 生产、风险分析、监管、测试。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴奋地举着一盆转基因小苗，指向窗外的农田
shots.prompt_en: The young male student excitedly holds up a potted seedling and points out the window toward farm fields.
shots.narration: 阿杰的小苗长得好，他想马上种到地里。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个小烧瓶，想象它变成一个巨大的发酵罐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a small flask while a thought bubble shows a giant fermentation tank.
shots.narration: 还想把小瓶培养，直接放大一百倍。

shots.scene: 老周按住花盆，摇头，拿出空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The older man gently holds the pot down, shakes his head and shows a blank flow chart.
shots.narration: 老周摇头：从实验室到生产，一步都不能跳。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这条路上，每一步都有安全关口。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白笔记本，旁边是暂停、回放图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank notebook and a pen, next to pause and replay icons.
shots.narration: 边看边记，需要时暂停回看。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标和政府建筑剪影
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shield and a simple government building silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 上一次学过，监管部门怎样把住安全关。

shots.scene: 灯泡沿着台阶走向一个产品盒
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb icon climbing a staircase toward a blank product box at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 这一次，看新成果怎样一步步变成产品。

shots.scene: 沙漏、放大镜、试验田三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an hourglass, a magnifying glass and a small test field plot. No people.
shots.narration: 新发现走向生产，要花大量时间，

shots.scene: 一层层的关卡门，产品盒逐个通过
shots.prompt_en: A blank product box passing through a series of gates one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 一道道检测和试验，验证可靠和影响。

shots.scene: 工厂图标旁一个问号：能稳定重复吗
shots.prompt_en: A factory icon producing identical boxes, with a question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 生产：能不能稳定、安全地重复制造？

shots.scene: 天平图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 风险分析：这个产品安全吗？

shots.scene: 盾牌图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon with a check mark and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 监管：符合国家的要求吗？

shots.scene: 试管图标，多次结果一致
shots.prompt_en: Three identical bar chart icons side by side with a test tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 测试：每次都能得到同样的结果吗？

shots.scene: 整洁的生产车间，老李在检查设备
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a clean lab coat checks equipment in a tidy, bright production room.
shots.narration: 良好生产规范，管的是质量和安全。

shots.scene: 记录本、培训、监测曲线、规程、扳手五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a logbook, a teacher at a board, a monitoring graph, a numbered procedure sheet and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 记录、培训、监测、规程、维护。

shots.scene: 工人按规程操作，旁边是高质量原料箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows a blank procedure sheet while weighing materials from a high-quality supply box.
shots.narration: 全过程按安全规程做，原料要合格。

shots.scene: 一排外形完全一致的产品盒
shots.prompt_en: A row of identical blank product boxes on a conveyor belt with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 每一批产品，质量都要一致。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白文件夹，图标为盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank folder with a shield icon.
shots.narration: 具体要求，按国家相应的规范执行。

shots.section_title: 风险分析：安全吗？值得吗？
shots.scene: 天平一边是风险图标，一边是收益图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a warning triangle on one side and a basket of harvest on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 风险分析，要把风险和收益放在一起称。
overlay: 风险分析：安全吗？值得吗？

shots.section_title: 风险分析：安全吗？值得吗？
shots.scene: 转基因作物图标连到环境、人和动物图标
shots.prompt_en: A genetically modified crop icon with arrows to a tree, a person silhouette and a cow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看它对环境、人和动物健康的影响，

shots.section_title: 风险分析：安全吗？值得吗？
shots.scene: 两株植物并排比较，一株带基因图标
shots.prompt_en: Two plants side by side for comparison, one marked with a small DNA icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还要和普通品种对比。

shots.section_title: 风险分析：安全吗？值得吗？
shots.scene: 不同生物和产品图标配不同的问题清单
shots.prompt_en: Different organism icons, a plant, a fish and a microbe, each with a different blank checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 改造的生物不同，要问的问题也不同。

shots.scene: 害虫图标长出盾牌，表示抗性
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pest insect growing a small shield, showing resistance. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会让害虫或杂草产生抗性？

shots.scene: 植物出现异常斑点的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plant showing unusual spots and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会出现不良性状？

shots.scene: 目标害虫和健康图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a target pest with a crosshair, and a heart with a plus sign for health. No people.
shots.narration: 对目标物种、对人和动物健康有何影响？

shots.scene: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶等非目标生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bee, a butterfly and an earthworm near a crop. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会伤到蜜蜂这样的非目标生物？

shots.scene: 基因图标从作物飘到野生近缘植物
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small DNA symbol drifting from a crop plant to a wild plant nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 基因会不会转移到别的物种？

shots.scene: 风险分级的阶梯图标
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with four steps colored from light to dark. No people.
shots.narration: 风险要分级管理：

shots.scene: 不易扩散、可恢复：一个小眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fenced plot with a reversible arrow and a small eye icon for light monitoring. No people.
shots.narration: 不易扩散、影响可逆的，监测可少些；

shots.scene: 容易扩散、不可逆：大眼睛和锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of seeds blowing far away with a one-way arrow, next to a large eye and a lock. No people.
shots.narration: 容易扩散、不可逆的，要严加管控。

shots.section_title: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例
shots.scene: 风险指数的三个格子
shots.prompt_en: Three blank boxes marked by icons: a broken branch, a wind arrow and a history book. No people.
shots.narration: 风险指数看三样：危害、暴露、先例。
overlay: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例

shots.section_title: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例
shots.scene: 破损的枝条图标，强度刻度
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a damaged branch with an intensity scale from low to high. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：真的出问题时，影响有多重。

shots.section_title: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例
shots.scene: 土壤、动物、本地植物三个图标被箭头波及
shots.prompt_en: Icons of soil, an animal and a native wildflower with arrows of exposure reaching them. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露：土壤、动物、本地植物接触多少，

shots.section_title: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例
shots.scene: 暴露越多，警示三角越大
shots.prompt_en: A row of warning triangles growing larger as exposure arrows increase. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露越多，出问题的可能越大。

shots.section_title: 风险指数：危害、暴露、先例
shots.scene: 翻开的历史书图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open history book with a small warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 先例：以前发生过类似的问题吗？

shots.section_title: 显著性指数：范围、可逆性
shots.scene: 显著性指数的两个格子：地图和回转箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two blank boxes marked by icons: a map with spreading circles and a circular return arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 显著性指数看范围和可逆性，
overlay: 显著性指数：范围、可逆性

shots.section_title: 显著性指数：范围、可逆性
shots.scene: 地图上标出种植地点
shots.prompt_en: A map icon with a pin marking a planting site and surrounding fields. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看在哪里种、当地环境怎样。

shots.section_title: 显著性指数：范围、可逆性
shots.scene: 圆圈从中心不断扩大
shots.prompt_en: Circles spreading outward from a center point on a map. No people.
shots.narration: 范围：危害会扩散多远。

shots.section_title: 显著性指数：范围、可逆性
shots.scene: 生态系统受扰后恢复原状的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small ecosystem disturbed, then a circular arrow back to its healthy state. No people.
shots.narration: 可逆性：系统能不能恢复原样。

shots.scene: 四乘四的方格，颜色从浅到深
shots.prompt_en: A four by four grid chart with cells shaded from white to black, axes marked only with small arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 两个指数一组合，就得出管控等级：

shots.scene: 五级图例：从打勾到禁止
shots.prompt_en: A five-level legend of icons: a green check, an eye, a gear, a lock, and a no-entry symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 不限制、要监测、要管理、要限制、不建议。

shots.scene: 方格右下角最深的一格亮起禁止标志
shots.prompt_en: The darkest bottom right cell of the grid lights up with a no-entry symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 两项都高，就不建议推广。

shots.scene: 政府建筑剪影前的盾牌和盖章文件
shots.prompt_en: A simple government building silhouette with a shield and a stamped blank document in front. No people.
shots.narration: 新技术进入市场，监管部门全程把关。

shots.scene: 食品、农业、环境三个部门图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a food plate, a wheat ear and a green leaf, each on a small building. No people.
shots.narration: 食品药品、农业、环境，各管一方面。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套用移液器向一排试管加样
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and goggles pipettes into a row of test tubes.
shots.narration: 产品要经过大量测试，

shots.scene: 多次实验结果一致的图标
shots.prompt_en: Several identical result charts lined up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看结果能否重复、是否达到预期，

shots.scene: 副作用的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a product box with a small unexpected side effect warning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 还要找出副作用和意外后果。

shots.scene: 实验室门通向一小块围起来的试验田
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab door opening onto a small fenced test plot. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室结果好，才可能做小范围田间试验。

shots.scene: 台阶式流程：实验室、温室、小块田、大田
shots.prompt_en: A staircase of icons: a lab bench, a greenhouse, a small fenced plot and a large field, with a stamp at each step. No people.
shots.narration: 我国转基因生物，按阶段管理，

shots.scene: 每一级台阶上都有盖章文件
shots.prompt_en: The same staircase with a blank stamped document at each step. No people.
shots.narration: 进入下一阶段，要按规定报告或审批。

shots.scene: 学生把小苗种到校园外的地里，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student planting a seedling in an open field outside campus, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 个人不能私自把材料种到田里。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师查看空白申请表
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator review a blank application form together.
shots.narration: 怎样申报，听实验室负责人和学校的。

shots.scene: 小烧瓶和大发酵罐之间画了乘号，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small flask times a multiplier equals a giant tank, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放大，不是简单地乘倍数。

shots.scene: 大罐周围的热量、压力、气雾图标
shots.prompt_en: A large fermentation tank icon surrounded by heat waves, a pressure gauge and an aerosol cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 体积变大，热量、压力和气溶胶都变了。

shots.scene: 老周和老李重新填写空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer fill in a blank risk assessment form beside a pilot-scale tank.
shots.narration: 放大前，要重新做风险评估，

shots.scene: 空白文件盖章
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank document receiving an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 经过审批，才能开始中试。

shots.section_title: 田间试验要隔离、防扩散
shots.scene: 围起来的试验田，四周有隔离带
shots.prompt_en: A small test field surrounded by a fence and a wide empty buffer strip. No people.
shots.narration: 田间试验，要设隔离，
overlay: 田间试验要隔离、防扩散

shots.section_title: 田间试验要隔离、防扩散
shots.scene: 花粉和种子被风吹出围栏的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pollen and seeds blowing over a fence, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止花粉、种子扩散出去。

shots.section_title: 田间试验要隔离、防扩散
shots.scene: 试验结束后残留植株装袋处理
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands bag leftover plants from a test plot for disposal.
shots.narration: 结束后，残留材料按规定处理，

shots.section_title: 田间试验要隔离、防扩散
shots.scene: 地块旁的监测记录本
shots.prompt_en: A blank monitoring logbook beside a cleared test plot. No people.
shots.narration: 后续还要继续监测、记录。

shots.scene: 老李在发酵罐旁检查压力表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a pressure gauge on a large stainless steel fermentation tank.
shots.narration: 发酵罐、灭菌器可能属于压力容器，

shots.scene: 空白证书和压力容器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank certificate and a pressure vessel with an inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 按特种设备管理，定期检验，

shots.scene: 未经培训的学生去拧阀门，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained student turning a valve on a large tank, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 未经培训授权，不能操作。

shots.scene: 工人穿防护服、戴护目镜进入车间
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a protective gown, goggles and gloves enters a production room after training.
shots.narration: 生产人员先培训，按要求穿戴防护。

shots.scene: 泄漏警示和应急预案文件夹图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spill warning sign and a blank emergency plan folder. No people.
shots.narration: 要有泄漏应急预案，平时要演练。

shots.scene: 阿杰拨打电话，旁边号码图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call, next to icons of the numbers 119 and 120.
shots.narration: 出事先报告负责人，必要时打119、120。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处高亮的空白条
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook page with three highlighted blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 看完标出三个要点，

shots.scene: 新旧两个笔记本用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Two notebook icons connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 想想和学过的知识有什么联系，

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问就问老师，笔记要保管好。

shots.section_title: 画出从实验室到市场的路
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研在大纸上画流程图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student draw a flow chart of icons on a large blank poster.
shots.narration: 最后的项目：画出从实验室到市场的路。
overlay: 画出从实验室到市场的路

shots.section_title: 画出从实验室到市场的路
shots.scene: 流程图上从实验台到消费者的一串图标
shots.prompt_en: A flow chart of icons from a lab bench to a factory, a test field, a stamp and a shopping cart. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步做什么、需要什么，都要写清。

shots.section_title: 画出从实验室到市场的路
shots.scene: 一大堆灯泡里只有一个走到终点
shots.prompt_en: Many light bulb icons start a long path but only one reaches the finish flag. No people.
shots.narration: 研究多年，能走到市场的成果很少。

shots.section_title: 画出从实验室到市场的路
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评分表讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank grading sheet and explains the project to the class.
shots.narration: 要求和评分标准，听老师安排。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现工厂、天平、盾牌、试管图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a factory, a balance scale, a shield and test tubes.
shots.narration: 生产、风险分析、监管、测试。

shots.scene: 风险矩阵和五级图例图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shaded four by four grid and a five-level legend. No people.
shots.narration: 危害、暴露、先例，范围、可逆性。

shots.scene: 台阶流程图每一级盖章
shots.prompt_en: A staircase of icons from lab to field with a stamp at every step. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因按阶段报批，放大前重新评估。

shots.scene: 隔离田、压力表、应急预案图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fenced test plot, a pressure gauge and an emergency plan folder. No people.
shots.narration: 田间要隔离，设备要合规，应急有预案。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在道路终点的超市门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the end of the path in front of a small grocery store.
shots.narration: 一步一关，安全落地，下次见！
